ata.title: Forward Fuselage Wiring — Cargo Compartment Wiring

abstract: Wiring diagram for the forward cargo compartment, covering the compartment lighting feeds, the smoke detection sampling loop and the loading system power and control runs behind the lining.

sections.purpose: This sheet gives the wiring of the forward cargo compartment behind the lining panels, including the lighting feeds, the smoke detection loop and the loading system runs.
sections.sheet_note: The sheet is drawn as a flattened development of the compartment, ceiling at the top and sidewall below, so that the whole run can be followed without turning the page. Every run on this sheet is behind a lining panel and is therefore invisible during a normal inspection. Where attenuation blankets are fitted, the blanket sits between the loom and the lining and the loom must be clipped to the structure rather than resting on the blanket; a loom lying on a blanket will chafe as the blanket settles.
sections.routing_note: The compartment feeds enter at the forward bulkhead, run aft along the ceiling at the crown line and drop at each light position. The smoke detection sampling loop runs on the opposite side of the crown from the power feeds and must keep the separation given in the notes. The loading system runs are the heaviest gauge on the sheet and are routed low on the sidewall.
